item.title: Who's running for California governor? See list of candidates for 2026 election
item.description: Ten major candidates are officially in the running for California governor, marking what political observers say is the most competitive gubernatorial primary the state has seen in years.

item.title: Joby air taxi makes Bay Area flight in FAA commercial approval push
item.description: Air taxis are set to start operating in multiple states this year as part of a push by the White House to get aircraft like Joby's electric air taxi approved by the FAA for commercial service.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Brief cooldown tomorrow before potential record-breaking heat
item.description: Count a one-day, brief cooldown tomorrow before temperatures rise again this weekend. High clouds will increase overnight and continue to filter the sun tomorrow.

item.title: Cal State East Bay men's basketball team begin postseason play after perfect regular season
item.description: The Pioneers are the first Division II team in 30 years to finish with a perfect regular season! But this team has their sights set on something much bigger: a national title.

item.title: Thousands celebrate Olympic gold medalist Alysa Liu at hometown rally in Oakland
item.description: Thousands gathered outside Oakland City Hall to celebrate the hometown hero Alysa Liu after she won not one but two gold medals for figure skating at the 2026 Olympics.

item.title: 'Mormon Wives' tackles secrets, lies and relationship resets in season four
item.description: #MomTok drama reaches new heights in season four of "The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives." The entire season is now streaming on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Trump administration sues California over state's nation-leading vehicle-emission rules
item.description: The Trump administration ramped up a battle with California over the state's nation-leading vehicle-emission standards Thursday, suing air regulators over rules aimed at curbing pollution from cars.

item.title: Parents of boy killed in Burlingame 'chain reaction' crash sue city, driver, e-bike rider's parents
item.description: Two months after the San Mateo County District Attorney's office declined to file criminal charges against the 19-year-old driver who crashed and killed 4-year-old Ayden Fang, his parents are seeking justice.

item.title: Deputies, suspect, and PG&E employee wounded during shooting in El Dorado County
item.description: A PG&E crew reported being shot at early Thursday morning at a residence, prompting a response from the El Dorado County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: Woman named Alysa Liu has Instagram suspended for sharing name with superstar skater
item.description: The 'other' Alysa Liu began getting messages intended for the superstar Olympic skater that became annoying, but worse, Meta kicked the young tech worker off Instagram as a possible imposter.
